cultural.vision_reason: This is a carved wooden Gelede helmet mask, a classic Yoruba masquerade object, though its material is wood rather than metal so the claimed category is wrong.

physical.title: helmet mask
physical.summary:
A carved wooden mask, for Gelede masquerade, with elaborate circular helmet coloured in black and red; the face compressed with large oval eyes and projecting lids, surrounded by raised lines extending through to the ears like spectacles; the ears e-shaped; the nose pierced through flared nostrils; with a broad ridge all round the edge, pierced with attachment holes beneath each ear; the hat cylindrical with chequered top and oblique bands alternating red and black; attached by two bowed uprights at the back and by two branches from the sides of hat, a circular
wooden 'belt' from which hangs on either side a curved wooden knife in a sheath; one knife, a piece of the belt and one ear are broken away, a further small piece is missing.
